description: Umbraco's extension mechanisms (Composers, collection builders, notification handlers, attribute discovery) and a catalogue of backend CMS extension points: property value converters, Management API endpoints, content finders, health checks, search indexing, package migrations, background jobs, and more. Use when making a feature extensible or choosing which extension point fits. Not for property editor UI, dashboards, sections or trees, which the official Backoffice Skills plugin covers.
